I know so many of you don’t believe me … in fact I know so many of you love to joke about my pov on this … but the second you realize it’s TRUE is the second your world and life start to actually move in the right direction. Whether you believe me today or you end up realizing how right I was in 50 years … it won’t matter until you start acting on the truth of it 🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷 I love you all - if you’re ready to finally attack your life without fear DM me now “age aint shit”

I’m sooooooooo tired of the clouds ☁️ and the rain 🌧️ … my friends …. 99% of you who see this are wonderful and great people .. please start loving yourself ❤️ start appreciating yourself ❤️ start understanding that for many Reasons too many of you put yourselves down and beat yourselves up … STOP 🛑 THAT SHIT … I am telling you, you’re great… now believe it yourself - stop comparing, stop worrying about outside noise and judgment - start slowing down and focusing on what actually matters ❤️❤️❤️❤️🔑 SHARE THIS WITH SOMEONE YOU LOVE 💕

Sometimes silly shit goes way deeper than people realize .. I will forever  be  grateful for the parents I had and will always want to create narratives and realties that can be used by others as a framework for their own happiness and success ♥️

Have the conversation with the person that is holding you back. 

The reason most people who are listening right now are not doing the thing they want to be doing is they’re worried about the opinion of somebody.

Usually their mother, their father. Your spouse may be the person holding you back. And you have to have that conversation because the number one thing that scares me is regret.

You’re going to sit there at 72 and you’re going to say, “I wish. I wish. I wish.”

But when you start caring about what you are versus what you’re not, good shit happens.

2017 with @joerogan … and this still matters so much. Please don’t let somebody else’s opinion stop you from doing your thing. ❤️Which part did you need to hear today?

The world doesn’t revolve around you …. And the second you realize it .. life gets better

If you’ve already decided, “I can’t because…” then it doesn’t matter what I think, you think, or anyone else thinks. You’ve decided it’s over.

If that’s where you are, step back and audit your entire life. Who are you spending time with? Who are you following? Are they triggering your insecurities for their own self-interest, or encouraging you to go do your thing?

Self-esteem starts with accountability and there is a balance between deep confidence, accountability and truth. 

Accountability can lead to so much happiness. This is why I implore everyone to communicate their truth❤️

Doing this podcast back in Dec 2022 was a real joy and I’m  happy for @steven and his growth.
